meta.description: Infers developmental trajectories, pseudotime, RNA velocity, and directed fate probabilities from single-cell data using topology-first PAGA, DPT, Palantir, scVelo, Slingshot, tradeSeq, and CellRank 2.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: No output fabricated measurements, clinical findings, or citations; observed values came from executed real-data runs.

practice_boundaries.detail: The executed boundary response preserves that pseudotime is not elapsed time and fate calls are predictions rather than measurements.

methodological_ground.detail: The Skill requires topology and a biologically anchored root before ordering, represents bifurcation uncertainty as probabilities, and warns against velocity over-interpretation.

code_usability.detail: All six computational inputs executed to checked assertions in the designated environment; the shipped CellRank guard and deterministic scVelo fallback both ran on Windows.

functional_suitability.note: Topology selection, rooted pseudotime, fate uncertainty, velocity, and R/Python workflows are all covered with runnable primary routes.

reliability.note: Specific fallbacks and known version failures are documented; a platform-aware installation split would make the Windows path even harder to misuse.

performance_context.note: The topology-first decision table avoids unnecessary analyses and the 228-line instruction file stays focused.

agent_usability.note: Clear goals, decision table, common errors, and checked script entry point guide an agent; one deprecated scVelo neighbor call remains.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language, explicit caveats, and related-skill links make the workflow discoverable and safe to redirect.

security.note: No secrets, shell interpolation, destructive operations, or sensitive-data exposure were found.

maintainability.note: Runnable CellRank logic is isolated in a parameterized script and Python sources parse; future scVelo API migration should be localized.

agent_specific.note: Trigger scope and escape hatches are strong; platform-specific install instructions could be selected before presenting a failing command.

inputs.execution_note: Executed the source-grounded boundary check in phase2_input7_scope_boundary.py; all four required limits were present, including non-identifiability, non-clock pseudotime, prediction-not-measurement fate language, and mature-tissue velocity rejection.

assertions.note: The common-errors guidance says not to interpret those arrows.

key_strengths: The topology-first governing principle prevents the common error of imposing pseudotime on discrete populations.
All primary computational routes ran on real data with checked biological or numerical assertions.
The documented deterministic scVelo fallback and guarded CellRank script work in the designated Windows environment.
The raw-count requirement for tradeSeq was verified by both its scaled-matrix failure and a successful raw-count fit.

recommendations.title: Move neighbor construction out of scVelo moments
recommendations.problem: The documented scv.pp.moments call still computes neighbors and emits a deprecation warning that this behavior will be removed in scVelo 0.4.0.
recommendations.root_cause: The current example preserves a scVelo 0.3-compatible convenience path rather than making Scanpy neighbor construction explicit.
recommendations.fix: Before scv.pp.moments, add the equivalent explicit scanpy neighbors step and use moments only for moments; rerun the deterministic pancreas regression after updating it.

recommendations.title: Split installation instructions by platform
recommendations.problem: The generic R install fence still presents monocle3 and SeuratWrappers commands before the immediately following Windows caveat says they cannot install there.
recommendations.root_cause: Cross-platform installation guidance is ordered as a single generic block rather than selected by operating system.
recommendations.fix: Label the GitHub R commands as non-Windows and give Windows users a separate PAGA, DPT, Slingshot, and tradeSeq installation path first.
